P01.note: Both standard placements of the 'except' phrase; Y is arguably the more common written form, X is fully idiomatic too.

P02.note: X is the expected sentence. Y is grammatical, but promising to return a book before borrowing it is an odd sequence. It still works as a relative clause naming a book he had committed to return.

P03.note: Y is the idiomatic sentence. X is grammatical, but the past perfect main clause beside a simple past relative clause ('she managed to finish') reads a little backwards; a native speaker might still write it.
